lessons.situation: A current invocation encounters a material checkpoint that elapsed after the last delivered currency assessment.
lessons.rule: Resolve the actual checkpoint package and subsequent decisive guidance before retaining the old currency pressure. Choose the earliest next material anchor. Keep the expired interval visible as unreviewed exposure; never renew direction by moving a clock or a save alone.
lessons.exceptions: A checkpoint need not reverse the verdict. Unknown actuals remain an exact research gap. Alarms and navigation do no research and never invoke an agent automatically.
lessons.validation_note: Verified saved-clock failure in the October 30 EUR history. This corrects the review process, not a learned directional edge.

lessons.situation: Repeated currency assessments default to the same grade, or a challenged trade tempts the analyst to increase intensity after seeing a large move.
lessons.rule: Justify intensity from the dominant verified mechanism against its strongest opposition. Compare equal-grade currencies over an overlapping horizon and state relative dominance or a genuine tie. Use Strong or Moderate when that causal dominance is supported; do not default to Slight because the outcome is uncertain.
lessons.exceptions: Different labels are never a quota or an entry signal. An aligned Slight, aligned Moderate and opposed Moderate all occur in the pilot; realised move size cannot establish the correct earlier fundamental grade.
lessons.validation_note: Process calibration backed by differently graded counterexamples. No clean prospective intensity-performance sample exists yet; no win-rate or profit claim.

lessons.situation: A multi-day domestic policy foundation is combined with a temporary haven, risk or financing premise from the previous session.
lessons.rule: State which part of the current verdict requires that temporary premise to persist, check fresh contrary information at the next relevant invocation anchor, and assess the domestic policy path separately. If the temporary channel was decisive, reassess its dominance before retaining the old grade.
lessons.exceptions: Do not require price confirmation or realised private flows for potential impact. A later adverse move alone does not prove the premise was wrong when assessed or justify an automatic currency reversal.
lessons.validation_note: Attention and decomposition rule motivated by an adverse JPY case, not an established causal explanation of that move. Directional hypotheses remain unproven.

lessons.situation: A multi-day domestic policy foundation is combined with a temporary haven, risk or financing premise from the previous session.
lessons.rule: Separate the domestic policy foundation from temporary haven, risk and financing premises. At the invocation cutoff, weigh already-published contrary changes in expected conditions, including credible negotiations, before retaining the previous session sign or grade. A potential-impact judgment need not wait for a final agreement, realised supply restoration, a rally headline or proof of private flows. Explain why one mechanism dominates the researched pair now.
lessons.exceptions: Talks can fail and risk can worsen. Energy-import relief may benefit both EUR and JPY, so compare their other channels rather than assuming the cross sign. BoJ tightening remains opposition; a later rally does not establish an earlier STRONG BUY or justify a current entry.
lessons.validation_note: Verified process and weighting criticism against original saved evidence and reopened dated bodies. No clean blind replay or directional edge is established; exact rally causality and a strong pre-cutoff buy remain unproven.
lessons.revision_note: November 2 cutoff audit identifies diplomacy already present in the original evidence, and adds the expectations-versus-realisation distinction with pair-specific exceptions.

lessons.situation: A saved currency call has a substantial remaining-day opportunity but a different result before its next checkpoint or supersession.
lessons.rule: Confront both records. Preserve an aligned post-delivery excursion as supporting evidence, investigate opposed active-window pressure and report the horizon limitation. Keep the day-open context separate so a late call cannot receive credit for earlier moves. Record adversity and time-to-peak before drawing a reusable lesson.
lessons.exceptions: Partial sampled paths do not establish exact wick extrema, executable profits or causal correctness. Neither a larger late move nor an adverse close automatically changes the original grade. A short checkpoint requires fresh research before extending the old call.
lessons.validation_note: Process lesson from exact frozen EUR and GBP calls with contrasting measurement windows. This is not evidence of a statistical edge or automatic model-weight training.
